explication: Lenis is a browser smooth-scrolling library. A host application creates a Lenis instance; browser wheel/touch and native scroll events enter the virtual-scroll layer, while an animation clock advances the engine. The engine measures dimensions, animates toward a target, updates the scroll surface, and emits scroll state back to the host. React and Vue providers expose this lifecycle through framework APIs, while the optional Snap package listens for virtual-scroll data and commands Lenis to aligned positions. Some adapter internals were not sampled, so those links remain limited to documented responsibilities.
